source.section: Record capital_gains empty: no rate or deduction in the booklet differs from ordinary income; Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 40,000.00 + dividends 6,000.00 + short-term gains 4,000.00 + long-term gains 15,000.00 = 65,000.00. Federal taxable income = 65,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 49,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 65,000.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 65,000.00 + 0.00 = 65,000.00. Schedule 2: no deductions; line 12 total = 0.00. IT-40 line 4 = 0.00. Line 5 = 65,000.00 - 0.00 = 65,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 0 x 1,000.00 = 0.00; line 5 nobody 65 or older: 0.00; line 7 total = 1,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 1,000.00. Line 7 = 65,000.00 - 1,000.00 = 64,000.00. Line 8 = 64,000.00 x 0.03 = 1,920.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 1,920.00. Gains and dividends are in federal AGI and pay the flat 3%.
